detail.title: Epistemic Justice and Foundational Assumptions in AI Metareasoning
detail.summary: AI metareasoning frameworks benefit from integrating epistemic justice to recognize community expertise and ethics-based auditing to structure validation of automated outcomes. Effective augmentation requires maintaining cognitive flow, which necessitates that systems adapt interventions to the user's current contextual state.
detail.reason: Revising to integrate EBA and cognitive flow findings into the metareasoning framework.
